description: OpenAI models for text generation, summarization, and structured extraction.

auth.label: OpenAI API key
auth.setup_notes: Create a key at platform.openai.com under API keys. Usage is billed to whoever owns the key, so prefer a project key over a personal one.

capabilities.description: Sends a prompt to an OpenAI chat model and returns the completion. Runs on the workflow owner's own credential and has nothing to do with the model that generated the workflow.

model.description: Which model to call. The mini models are an order of magnitude cheaper and are the right default for classification and extraction.

prompt.description: The user message. Reference upstream data with expressions rather than restating it.
prompt.example: Summarise this support ticket in one sentence: {{ n_ticket.body }}

system_prompt.description: Instructions that frame the task. This is the workflow author's own prompt: no FlowForge system prompt is ever injected into a generated step.
system_prompt.example: You are a support triage assistant. Answer in one sentence.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Use 0 for classification and extraction, where a stable answer matters more than a varied one.

max_tokens.description: Upper bound on the response length. A bound here is what stops a runaway response costing more than the workflow saves.

output_schema.description: A JSON Schema the response must match. Supplying one makes the reply parseable, and its fields become referenceable by downstream steps.

finish_reason.description: Why generation stopped. A value of length means max_tokens truncated the answer.

rate_limit.notes: Depends on the account's usage tier rather than being fixed.
